description: NaBiTe₂ is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent Te²⁻ atoms to form NaTe₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BiTe₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaTe₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent BiTe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°. All Na-Te bond lengths are 3.26 Å. Bi³⁺ is bonded to six equivalent Te²⁻ atoms to form BiTe₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaTe₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaTe₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent BiTe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°. All Bi-Te bond lengths are 3.16 Å. Te²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Bi³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing TeNa₃Bi₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
